name: Boost Spell-like Ability
benefit: The saving throw (DC) of a boosted spell-like ability is increased by +2. Each of your spell-like abilities can be boosted three time a day, though the feat does not allow the creature to exceed its normal usage limit for any ability.

name: Boost Spell Resistance
benefit: If the character already has innate spell resistance, he gains a +2 profane bonus to his existing spell resistance score.

name: Corrupt Spell-like Ability
benefit: This feat adds the evil descriptor to a spell-like ability. Furthermore, if the spell-like ability deals damage, half of that damage (rounded down) is unholy damage.

name: Poison Immunity
benefit: The character is immune to one specific poison usable as a blade poison, the venom of a specific creature, or one other toxin. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus on saving throws against other poisons.

name: Violate Spell-like Ability
benefit: This feat adds the evil descriptor to a spell-like ability. Furthermore, if the spell-like ability deals damage, half of that damage (rounded down) is vile damage.

name: Violate Spell
benefit: This feat adds the evil descriptor to a spell. Furthermore, if the spell deals damage, half of the damage dealt is vile damage.

name: Dark Speech
prerequisites: Base Will save bonus +5, Int 15, Cha 15
prereq: Base Will save bonus +5, Int 15, Cha 15
benefit: The character can use the Dark Speech to bring loathing and fear to others, to help cast evil spells and create evil magic items, and to weaken physical objects.

name: Disciple Of Darkness
benefit: Once per day, while performing an evil act, the character may call upon his diabolic patron to add a +1 luck bonus on any one die roll.

name: Evil Brand
benefit: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks made against evil creatures.

name: Lich Loved
benefit: Mindless undead see the character as an undead creature. Becoming more and more like an actual undead creature, he gains a +1 circumstance bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects, poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning and disease.

name: Vile Ki Strike
benefit: Each time the character deals damage with his unarmed strike, the deals 1 additional point of vile damage.

name: Sacrificial Mastery
benefit: The character gains a +4 profane bonus on Knowledge (religion) checks made when performing a sacrifice.

name: Thrall To Demon
benefit: Once per day, while performing an evil act, the character may call upon his demonic patron to add a +1 luck bonus on any one roll.

name: Verminfriend

name: Vile Martial Strike
prerequisites: Cha 15, Weapon Focus with the specified weapon
prereq: Cha 15, Weapon Focus with the specified weapon
benefit: Each time the character deals damage with a specific kind of weapon, she deals 1 additional point of vile damage.

name: Vile Natural Attack

prereq: Natural attack that deals at least 1d8 points of damage, BAB +5
benefit: Each time the character deals damage with his natural attack, he deals 1 additional point of vile damage.

name: Deformity (Eyes)

name: Deformity (Obese)
benefit: The character gains a +2 deformity bonus to Constitution and a -2 deformity penalty to Dexterity. Furthermore, she gains a +2 circumstance bonus on intimidate checks and saving throws against poison.

name: Spell Girding
benefit: Any dispel checks against your spells are made with a -2 penalty.

name: Spellfire Wielder
prerequisites: Must be chosen at first level.
prereq: Must be chosen at first level.
benefit: You can use spellfire to absorb spell energy, fire destructive blasts, or heal others, as described in the Spellfire section of the Magic of Faerun.

prereq: Int 13, Craft (gemcutting) skill, arcane spellcaster level 3rd.
